name: ab-av1
notes: 2026-11-01: Searches for the CRF that meets a target VMAF, then encodes; JSON output and atomic writes.
2026-11-01: Triage: assess. Report rates it a strong candidate.
summary: Chooses CRF against a target VMAF/XPSNR threshold, then encodes through FFmpeg. The Rust CLI exposes search, encode and quality-measurement commands; its distinctive value is automating quality/size trade-offs across FFmpeg encoders.
use_when: Search CRF settings to meet a VMAF target before encoding
Compare video quality with VMAF or XPSNR from a CLI
Prefer over raw FFmpeg when repeatable quality targeting matters
avoid_when: Use FFmpeg directly for a fixed encoder configuration
Use a dedicated perceptual metric workflow when exact metric methodology is required

assessment.rationale: The official changelog shows v0.10.2 and the repository has current issue activity through 2026-11-08. Release date was not established from the sources read; documentation assessment only.
